[[Brigadier General]] '''Nevar''' was a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Battles" /> [[Imperial officer]] that served in the [[Imperial Army|ground forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Military|military]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth]], Nevar commanded the [[All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[walker]] [[Blizzard 2]] of [[Blizzard Force]], under the overall direction of [[General]] [[Maximilian Veers]]. Nevar's Blizzard 2 was the first Imperial [[walker]] downed by defending [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] forces using the [[Magnetic harpoon|harpoon and tow cable]] of [[Rogue Three]], a [[snowspeeder]] crewed by [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Wes Janson]].<ref name="CL 2016" />
